acceptanceCriteria.text: An http(s) reference on a card or ticket renders as a link that opens through window.dm.openExternal.
Other references render as before, as plain text.
Both panels use the one ReferenceList, and the listed tests pass.

body:
Both the card panel (src/renderer/src/kanban/KanbanCardPanel.tsx:160-171) and the ticket Overview (src/renderer/src/ticket/panelTabs.tsx:109-120) draw references as plain ew-mono text. Only evidence artifacts get links (panelTabs.tsx:186-188 isWebLocation, :203-206 SafeLink). ## Do 1. New src/renderer/src/ticket/ReferenceList.tsx: move isWebLocation here from panelTabs.tsx:186-188 and export it. Export ReferenceList({ references }: { references: TicketReference[] }): null when empty; else

REFERENCES

    . Each
  • keeps key `${kind}:${location}` and text `label === location ? location : \`${label} (${location})\``; when isWebLocation(location) the text sits in , otherwise . 2. src/renderer/src/ticket/panelTabs.tsx: replace lines 109-120 with ; delete the local isWebLocation and import it from ./ReferenceList for ArtifactList. 3. src/renderer/src/kanban/KanbanCardPanel.tsx: replace lines 160-171 with . ## Out of scope Linking non-http(s) references; the editors; expected artifacts. ## Tests - New src/renderer/src/ticket/ReferenceList.test.tsx (jsdom): an https reference renders a link named "Design doc (https://example.test/design)" whose click calls a mocked window.dm.openExternal with the URL; a file reference renders text and no link; an empty list renders nothing. - src/renderer/src/kanban/KanbanCardPanel.test.tsx:304: also assert getByRole('link', { name: /Design doc/ }) inside the References region. - src/renderer/src/ticket/panelTabs.overview.test.tsx:40-58: add a url reference and assert it is a link; the existing file references have no link role. ## Rules This card is the complete fix: nothing it finds is left for a later card. Fix anything that blocks a criterion inside this card. Run the listed tests, `npm run typecheck`, and `npx oxlint` on the touched files.
title: Render card and ticket references as links
